verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say it supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing and accepts traces from any OpenTelemetry-compatible application or agent. It also describes routing through an OpenTelemetry Collector that fans out to multiple destinations, and a community reply confirms the OpenTelemetry integration. Missing for 10: documentation of the OTLP endpoint and protocol details (HTTP/gRPC, semantic conventions), and evidence that traces can be exported out of LangSmith over OTLP rather than only through its UI/API.
